programs.title: Spoolin' Up With the DeBertis: Mini Bike Mania
programs.desc: Madera is a master builder of minibikes, and brings in enough bikes to stage a race for shop glory  Brad has a vision for a hilarious social media video and hits the streets of Pismo with the crew and their 1961 van.

programs.title: All Girls Garage: Cutlass Convertible Repair
programs.desc: Most convertible tops from the late 60s, early 70s have problems  the AGG crew will demonstrate how to replace and rebuild a convertible top from top to bottom.

programs.title: Roadkill Garage
programs.desc: The guys attempt a three-day overhaul of the 351 Cleveland engine from the '67 Mercury Cougar that belonged to David Freiburger when the show began, but transferred to Steve Dulcich before the shoot was over.

programs.title: Roadkill Garage
programs.sub_title: Wrenching for Speed in the Roadkill Crop Duster!
programs.desc: David, Steve and a '70 Plymouth Duster return to the drag strip in search of the elusive 11-second quarter mile  the car has a new 500-horsepower 383 and the guys are ready to attack their demons and have fun in the process.

programs.title: Bad Chad Customs
programs.desc: Chad takes on his first build under his new banner at Hiltz Automotive  the team takes a stubborn '57 Cadillac and transforms it into a futuristic, chromed-out roadster fit for a king.

programs.title: Downey's Dream Cars: The Thanos Thumper
programs.desc: Robert Downey Jr. converts his K10 truck to an all-electric  he test-drives two electric cars, including the world's fastest-accelerating production car.
